entries.16dbcbefb7ea60c3: A semiconductor-related manufacturer based in Amagasaki, Hyogo Prefecture, whose main product is probe cards, components for semiconductor testing, and which also makes electron tube components.
entries.1ed7cb9939691cd6: This is a probe card that uses probe units based on MEMS (micro electro mechanical systems) technology. The company offers the MC, ML and MT series.
entries.2d86622fb286effa: Its probe cards include the cantilever-type C-type, the vertical-type V-type and the M-type using MEMS technology, and it independently develops and manufactures a wide range of products that support higher integration and higher speeds of semiconductors. In research and development, it is advancing improvements in the performance of probes using MEMS technology, substrate development, and development of probe cards for next-generation semiconductors.
entries.344ae1f80a401e2d: This is the main business, developing, manufacturing and selling components for semiconductor testing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,142 million, accounting for almost all consolidated revenue. The company and seven overseas consolidated subsidiaries are responsible for it, producing at the Kumamoto Office, the head office, the Mita Plant, and the subsidiary plants in Taiwan, Shanghai, the United States and Thailand. Its main customers are semiconductor manufacturers.
entries.344d2f2d18f317c0: Japan Electronic Materials is a company whose main business is the development, manufacture and sale of probe cards for semiconductor testing components, and which also produces cathodes and filaments for electron tube components.
entries.37bd2fd702583712: This business is the company's cathodes and filaments for electron tube components.
entries.3846e8ce36b10487: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,451 million, up 57.8% year on year. In addition to higher revenue, the high operating rate of domestic plants contributed, and the company achieved record revenue and net income since its founding.
entries.3b1343db00988583: The fiscal year ended March 2026, which falls within the medium-term plan period, saw production capacity raised through full operation of the fourth plant at the Kumamoto Works, completed two years earlier, and continuous capital investment in existing plants, leading to expanded sales of probe cards for memory products.
entries.3c4cfc7a533194e6: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,366 million, up 23.2% year on year. The semiconductor testing components business accounted for the bulk of revenue at ¥29,142 million, as sales of probe cards for memory products advanced significantly.

entries.5f3543e07e9cb432: The semiconductor testing components business is the main business, accounting for nearly all consolidated revenue. As demand for advanced semiconductors, such as those for data centers, image-processing semiconductors for generative AI and high-bandwidth memory (HBM), continues, sales of probe cards for memory products have expanded, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 reached a record high since the company's founding. On the other hand, demand for probe cards for non-memory products was sluggish. By revenue, the breakdown is centered on Japan and Asia.

entries.b858408629291437: The fiscal year ended March 2026, which falls within the medium-term plan period, saw production capacity raised through full operation of the fourth plant at the Kumamoto Works, completed two years earlier, and continuous capital investment in existing plants, leading to expanded sales of probe cards for memory products. The company plans to fund construction of the Amagasaki plant with its own funds and proceeds from a capital increase, and it also issued new shares through a public offering during the period.
entries.c3274e0b7136603f: This is a probe card with vertical probes, mainly used for higher integration and higher speed of semiconductors. It includes the VT series, which uses vertical contact; the VS series, which uses vertical spring contact; and the VE series, which combines vertical and cantilever probes.

entries.c6e3f55aaf525ceb: It states its corporate philosophy as 'contributing to society through the development and commercialization of technology that brings happiness to humankind', and under the medium-term management plan covering fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026, it aims to strengthen product capabilities and production capacity through active capital and development investment. For M-type probe cards (probe cards using MEMS technology), whose growth is expected to continue, it will strengthen its production system and improve production efficiency, and will advance development of probe cards for next-generation semiconductors; in February 2026 it resolved to build a new plant in Amagasaki, Hyogo Prefecture. Preparations are under way for completion of the new plant in August 2028.
